method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING.md §6.5 manual/fan-out validation (run_loop.py uses select(), broken on Windows per §6.4). FULL RE-RUN 2026-06-11 against the read-framed description (HCBR-2026-06-11-03 fix: 'Author or interpret', read-side audit cases, 'before writing or reading' closing): all 20 original queries re-measured + 6 new (q21-24 read-side should-trigger; q25-26 read-shaped should-not near-misses). Empirical step = independent fan-out of 26 fresh-context agents, one per query, each shown a neutral menu of 9 skill descriptions (kid-authoring at C among realistic siblings, NOT flagged as under-test; sibling authoring skills shown with abridged versions of their own new read-framed descriptions, matching deployment) + one query, asked which ONE skill to load (or NONE) + reasoning. Anonymized per feedback_skill_trigger_eval_fanout; agents told to judge ONLY the menu, use no tools beyond reading it, and ignore environment skills. Verdicts adjudicated from each agent's REASONING + pick. Menu: A=SkyPatcher edit-record-fields, B=SPID distribute-to-NPCs, C=KID keywords-to-items [under test], D=CID items-to-containers, E=mutagen-reference record-schema, F=crash-diagnostics, G=conflict-resolution, H=papyrus-reference, I=modding-basics. Menu + raw run-record in dev/skill-validation/2026-06-11-read-triggers/ (private). Supersedes the 2026-06-04 run (whose 20 queries are q1-q20 here, all verdicts reconfirmed; the C/D letter-adjacency wobble noted in that run did not recur).

result.notes: All 14 should-trigger picked C — the 10 originals (write-side, reconfirmed; q6's trimmed 'destruction spell tomes' phrase still fires via books + 'tag all ... with a keyword') and all 4 new read-side cases: q21 does-this-_KID-tag-X, q22 pre-install read-which-items-it-tags, q23 why-isn't-the-line-applying, q24 audit-for-double-tagging (agent also cited ExclusiveGroup). All 12 should-not routed elsewhere, incl. the two new read-shaped near-misses: q25 (what does this _DISTR.ini distribute → B) and q26 (what does this skypatcher ini change → A) — framework beat read-verb both times. Hard originals all held: q14 keyword-to-NPCs → B (the KID/SPID boundary), q18 scripted keyword-on-pickup → H, q19/q20 name KID but are install/conceptual → I. Every manual_predicted_trigger matched the measured verdict.
result.peer_review: Author prediction + 26 independent fresh-context agents (exceeds §6.5's 'one peer reviewer checks 3 random'). Re-run required by PR #42 independent review (stale-eval blocking finding). Aaron may spot-check any query.
result.carry_forward: KI-KID-V1X-1: re-run on the next release that ships a Windows-compatible eval runner (run_loop.py select() fix), per §6.4.
